sentences.en: Sami told Layla that the herbal tea would make her better.
sentences.zh: 萨米告诉莱拉，喝草本茶会让她感觉好些。

sentences.en: This herbal ointment relieves pain and promotes healing.
sentences.zh: 这种草本药膏可以缓解疼痛并促进愈合。

sentences.en: The TV commercial for herbal supplements ended with a quickly spoken disclaimer.
sentences.zh: 电视广告中的草本补充剂以快速念出的免责声明结尾。
